title: ModawemDrugDrugInteractionRecord
description: Schema definition for Modawem drug-drug interaction (DDI) dataset records.

record_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific source record. Must not be empty.

interaction_group_id.description: Canonical group identifier representing the active ingredient pair across multiple sources.

ingredient_a_name.description: Standardized active ingredient name for entity A.

ingredient_a_id.description: Identifier for ingredient A within ingredient_a_id_system.

ingredient_a_id_system.description: Coding system for ingredient A (e.g., RxNorm, UNII, CAS, internal).

ingredient_b_name.description: Standardized active ingredient name for entity B.

ingredient_b_id.description: Identifier for ingredient B within ingredient_b_id_system.

ingredient_b_id_system.description: Coding system for ingredient B (e.g., RxNorm, UNII, CAS, internal).

interaction_type.description: Clinical or pharmacological interaction mechanism (e.g. pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic, additive, antagonism, unspecified).

severity.description: Source-specific severity rating (e.g., Major, Moderate, Minor, Contraindicated, Severe). Must preserve source classification.

clinical_effect.description: Description of observed or predicted clinical consequence.

management_guidance.description: Clinical recommendations, dose adjustment, monitoring parameters, or alternative treatments.

source_id.description: Stable identifier for the primary source organization or database.

source_record_id.description: Original record or interaction identifier within the originating source.

source_version.description: Release identifier, build number, or publication date of the source.

source_url.description: Direct URL or canonical documentation link for the source record.

retrieved_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp recording when the record was extracted.

validation_status.description: Current lifecycle validation state of the record.

notes.description: Contextual annotations, clinical review rationale, or conflict notes.
